theorems.name: Submission.mean_curvature_comp_chart_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M → (∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → (∀ x ∈ V, ∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ ψ x a) (fderiv ℝ ψ x b) = normalPart M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x a b)) → ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ meanCurvature M (ψ x)) V
